run_mask_rcnn_r101_cascade: run the detectron2 Mask R-CNN model with ResNet-101 backbone, FPN, and cascade ROI heads for attribute detection
run_paco_training_r101: run PACO training with a ResNet-101 backbone using cascade ROI heads over 100 epochs
review_config_override: review the config override that changes backbone depth from 50 to 101 and sets eval_period to 5000000
summarize_r101_cascade_config: summarize the ResNet-101 cascade Mask R-CNN configuration inheriting from r50_attr_fpn_cascade_100_ep
test_r101_eval_period: test that the eval_period is correctly set to 5000000 in the R101 cascade configuration
